newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut's BBC bank to issue $12 mln Euro CDs.
newsitem.headline: Beirut's BBC bank to issue $12 mln Euro CDs.

text.p: Banque Beyrouth pour le Commerce announced on Thursday a $12 million issue of 18-month dollar-denominated certificates of deposit -- its second EuroCD issue this year.
Placement in Lebanon and abroad in denominations of $100,000 will begin on May 6 and the issue will mature on November 6, 1998, the bank said in a statement. It will be managed by the bank itself.
The CDs are payable in three equal semi-annual payments with a fixed interest rate of 8.25 percent, 2.25 points over similar U.S. Treasuries, the statement said.
BBC made a similar $12 million 18-month EuroCD issue on January 22 with an interest rate of 8.5 percent.
It will be the seventh EuroCD issue the bank has made since May 1995 and will bring the total to $64 million.
